terminal_record.title: Lawsuit Alleges ICE Shared Iranian Asylum Seekers’ Immigration Files with Iran
terminal_record.description_short: A 2026 lawsuit alleges that U.S. officials shared Iranian asylum seekers’ confidential immigration files with Iran beginning in March 2025; DHS denies it.
terminal_record.description_medium: A July 2026 complaint by the Iranian American Legal Defense Fund alleges that the Trump administration adopted a policy in March 2025 to give Iran confidential immigration-file information about Iranian asylum seekers. The complaint says ICE and Iranian officials held monthly meetings to share records. CNN reported the suit and quoted a DHS spokesperson denying the allegation. These are allegations, not court findings; the complaint seeks declaratory and injunctive relief.
terminal_record.description_long: On July 7, 2026, the Iranian American Legal Defense Fund filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia through Public Citizen. The complaint alleges that the Trump administration adopted a policy in March 2025 to provide the Iranian government with confidential immigration-file information about Iranians seeking asylum in the United States. It says ICE and Iranian officials held monthly meetings to share records of people in ICE custody and that officials also sent or hand-delivered files. The complaint alleges that hundreds of Iranian detainees seeking asylum were affected and argues that disclosure could endanger applicants and relatives; those claims have not been adjudicated. CNN reported the complaint and quoted a Department of Homeland Security spokesperson saying the allegations that ICE shared asylum application records with Iran were false. The complaint asks the court for declaratory and injunctive relief, so no finding of unlawful sharing or resulting persecution is established here. The evidence is limited to Iranian asylum seekers and the Iranian government. The supplied date of March 1 is only a month-level anchor: the complaint says March 2025, not a specific day. The broader frozen claim about sharing detailed information with multiple foreign governments and documented targeting cases is not supported by these sources and is excluded.

source_fact_map.source_excerpt: 25. The March 2025 meeting produced an agreement between the U.S. government and the Iranian Government under which ICE and Iranian Government officials have been holding monthly meetings to share the immigration files and information of Iranians in ICE custody. In addition, since the March 2025 meeting, U.S. government officials have periodically mailed or hand delivered immigration files of Iranians in ICE custody to the Iranian Government.

source_fact_map.fact: The complaint alleges that detailed information about hundreds of Iranian detainees seeking asylum was provided; this remains an allegation in the filing.

source_fact_map.source_excerpt: 30. The U.S. government has provided Iranian Interest Section officials with detailed information on hundreds of Iranian detainees seeking asylum, including information protected from disclosure by 8 C.F.R. § 208.6(a) and 8 C.F.R. § 236.1(e).

source_fact_map.source_excerpt:
Jul 7, 2026

PUBLISHED Jul 7, 2026, 6:22 PM ET

A newly filed lawsuit alleges that the Trump administration shared confidential information with Tehran about Iranian asylum seekers as it worked to deport them from the United States.

According to the lawsuit, filed Tuesday in the US District Court of the District of Columbia, many Iranian asylum seekers in the US are pro-democracy protestors, members of religious minorities, or members of the LGBTQ community.

It was filed by Public Citizen on behalf of the Iranian American Legal Defense Fund.
